messages:
maria_ae: Quick heads-up — BigWave (enterprise POC) sent a security questionnaire and a few blockers are blocking exec sign-off. Legal + Security want answers on in-transit key rotation, BYOK/HSM support, and an egress pricing estimate for 100M tokens/mo. Can we escalate and consolidate answers in one place?

sam_se: On it. Clarifying Q: are they running the trial on hosted or are they expecting Dedicated from day 1?

maria_ae: Hosted trial today; they want Dedicated for production. For now legal wants cert rotation cadence, KMS options, and whether we can provide a FIPS/HSM attestation.

jon_security: We can provide TLS details (TLS1.3, strong cipher suites). BYOK is supported for Private (HSM-backed). If they require FIPS-validated HSM attestation, that forces a Private deployment or a special Dedicated offering — need to confirm requirement.

elaine_legal: They also requested our SOC2 report and a DPA. I have the SOC2 PDF ready to share. I can draft the DPA, but need 48 hours to get internal sign-off from Privacy.

raj_eng: I can pull exact cipher suite list and cert rotation schedule. Also can prepare a short config snippet for IP allowlist + RBAC for their ops team.

maria_ae: They also want a ballpark for egress/pricing: estimate for 100M generation tokens + 10M embedding tokens/month. Need something conservative for the exec call.

sam_se: Quick back-of-envelope: hosted committed tier should land around ~$38k/mo for that volume (includes token and embedding discounts). Dedicated could be cheaper at scale — I'll prepare a 2-line comparison. Pinged @finance for committed-discount confirmation.

deploy-bot: Shared docs: https://redwood.internal/pocs/bigwave/security-package (access: sales + sec + legal).

jon_security: Copying the questionnaire snippet they sent for visibility: ```Encryption in transit: TLS version and cipher suites?
Key management: customer-managed keys required? HSM (FIPS) required?
Rotation: certificate rotation cadence required?```

elaine_legal: I'll attach SOC2 and start the DPA draft. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial DPA draft. Recommend we schedule a 30m sync with their GC — when are execs free?

maria_ae: Proposed timeline: consolidate technical answers today, DPA draft by EOD tomorrow, pricing summary + recommended path (hosted vs dedicated) for Friday exec call. Can everyone confirm they can hit those? :thumbsup:

sam_se: I can deliver the tech summary today before 5pm PT.

jon_security: I’ll provide attestations/cipher list and notes on HSM implications by 4pm PT.

raj_eng: Config snippet + rotation schedule by 3pm PT.

elaine_legal: DPA draft by EOD tomorrow.

maria_ae: Great — I’ll consolidate into a single one-pager and loop in the execs. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
